hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; r="${f#"$d"/}"; b="$d/.venv/bin/black"; [ -x "$b" ] || b=black; i="$d/.venv/bin/isort"; [ -x "$i" ] || i=isort; case "$r" in doc/*) ;; *) "$b" --config "$d/pyproject.toml" "$f";; esac; case "$r" in pennylane/*|tests/*) "$i" --settings-path "$d/pyproject.toml" "$f";; esac;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
